text:
Tanya: Heads up — canary showing 502 spikes from proxy after the last shard deploy. Deploy-bot flagged it. Suggest pin back proxy image and fast-track a hotfix window.

deploy-bot: AUTO: Canary failure rate exceeded threshold (502s) for service=proxy-eu1. Rollback available: /deploy rollback proxy eu1 --to gcr.io/redwood/proxy@sha256:abcd1234. Logs: https://deploy.logs/1801777777

samir: can you paste failing sample logs? wondering if it's config or image binary

liz: failing requests look like TLS handshake errors + aborted streams, not typical app-level bug

qa-mike: reproduced locally on staging with same image; proxy v2026-11-9 has regressive net-layer changes

Tanya: proposing pin to previous image v2026-11-3 (sha256:aa11aa11). Requesting ops signoff to expedite within change window 23:15-23:45 UTC

ops-oncall: I'm on it. Prefer pin + gradual traffic shift back rather than full instant rollback

samir: agree — pin + 50% shift, smoke, then full shift. I can patch rollout policy in Deploy console

Tanya: commands I ran:
```
# pin image
/deploy set-pinned proxy eu1 gcr.io/redwood/proxy:v2026-11-3
# quick rollback (if needed)
/deploy rollback proxy eu1 --to gcr.io/redwood/proxy:v2026-11-3 --no-canary
```

deploy-bot: CONFIRM: Pin set to v2026-11-3 by @tanya. Rollback initiated by @tanya. Job id: dj-7890. Monitoring: https://mon.redwood/proxy/eu1/dj-7890

ops-oncall: OK from ops. I'll monitor metrics for 15m. :thumbsup:

liz: note for release notes: 'Hotfix: pin proxy to v2026-11-3 to mitigate TLS handshake regression in v2026-11-9'

qa-mike: smoke after pin — 0 errors on 2000 requests. Handshake patterns restored in logs

samir: shifting remaining 50% now

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC_SHIFT: traffic for proxy-eu1 shifted to v2026-11-3 (100%) by @samir. All green checks passing

Tanya: tagging @release-manager for changelog + postmortem trigger

release-manager: noted. I'll draft release note and schedule a short blameless postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all

ops-oncall: keeping watch for 30m, will escalate if anything

liz: adding a rollback block to prow jobs to prevent auto-retries during the window

Tanya: thanks team — closing thread after monitoring window. :lock:
